title: Amazon Best Sellers charts
description: Two row types share one dataset: product (one chart entry with its rank, charged) and status (per category, free).

dataset.title: Amazon Best Sellers charts
dataset.description: One row per product on a Best Sellers, New Releases or Movers & Shakers chart, plus one status row per category. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
